posts.title: KittyBrowser: A Real Web Browser Inside Your Terminal
posts.description: I kept switching out of my terminal to check a page. So I put the browser in the terminal.

posts.title: Hushhh: Dictation on the Caps Lock Key
posts.description: I built a Mac dictation app in about a day. Press Caps Lock, talk, and your words appear at the cursor in any app.

posts.title: ArcLight: Live Video, Built Like a Slide Deck
posts.description: I got tired of juggling scene software and a slide deck every time I went on camera. So I built the tool I wanted: build it like a deck, then press play.
